messages:
maria-g: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we called out runbook/playbook gaps around the KV cache eviction + autoscaler flapping. Need owners and deadlines for: triage steps, immediate mitigation commands, and escalation path. Can folks volunteer?

jason-w: I can own the triage steps and commands. I want to scope the exact checks first.

lee: thanks. i'll draft the CLI snippet for SRE playbook and add a short checklist for on-call.

sara: pinging @jason-w @lee — curious on timelines. are we aiming EOW or next sprint? :calendar:

jason-w: EOW for draft, next sprint for reviews + merge. will post PR link when done.

oncall-bot: Action logged: "runbook: add kv-cache eviction triage" assigned to jason-w due 2026-05-10.

maria-g: assign owner for escalation path (who calls pager, who slices traffic, who triggers fallback)? we need explicit names not teams.

lee: i'll take escalation path. i'll add exact phone/escalation order and a fallback play to route to smaller model pool.

jason-w: here is the triage checklist i'll add to runbook (WIP):
```bash
# quick health checks
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep runtime
kubectl top pods -n inference --containers
# inspect cache metrics\curl -sS http://runtime-mgr:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit
# if cache miss spike, restart pod group\kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-mgr -n inference
```

sara: that looks good. can you also add the quick query to pull recent autoscaler events?

jason-w: yup: `kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector involvedObject.kind=HorizontalPodAutoscaler --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50`

lee: adding escalation snippet, will include exact Slack channel + on-call steps. sample: 
"If latency > 2000ms and error rate > 3% for 5m -> page @sre-oncall -> if no ack in 10m -> page infra-lead -> start model-fallback runbook"

maria-g: please include who should approve rolling fallback for Dedicated customers vs Hosted; we need decision table in playbook.

jason-w: noted — i'll add a short decision table and a playbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/436 (draft)

sara: can we add a recurring check so we catch the pattern earlier? maybe a daily cron that emits kv cache hit ratio alerts to PagerDuty when trend > 10% drop over 1h.

lee: agree. i'll propose an alert config and a dashboard link in the playbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook-update #436 assigned to jason-w, comment deadline 2026-05-07.

maria-g: final ask — please call out any temporary mitigations that should be automated (restarts, scale overrides, cache priming). We want automation owners for those too.

jason-w: automation owner for restart/scale override = jason-w. cache priming automation I'd like to pair with devex (cc @devex) but can own the initial script.

lee: automation owner for fallback routing = lee. i'll add playbook step to flip traffic and validate.

sara: thanks all. i'll consolidate this into the postmortem follow-up tracker and add Due dates. will remind owners mid-week. :thumbsup:

maria-g: perfect. we'll run a quick readout in next incidents sync. marking this thread for follow-up.

oncall-bot: Follow-up checklist created: [runbook draft, escalation path, automation scripts, alert rules]. Owners: jason-w, lee. Due: 2026-05-10.
